source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting failed building fire-safety checks

1. Start with the inspection records.
2.
completion:
3. Note the date and time of the inspection.
4. Identify the building and specific areas inspected.
5. Record the names and titles of the inspectors and the authority they represent.
6. List down each fire safety system and item checked (e.g., fire alarms, extinguishers, sprinkler systems, evacuation plans, etc.)
7. Detail the specific failures or deficiencies identified for each system/item.
   - E.g., fire alarm systems are not operational, fire extinguishers are expired or missing, sprinkler systems not functioning or heads are painted over, evacuation plans not posted or not updated, blocked or inadequately marked exits, etc.
8. Document any observations and findings with clear, concise, and objective language.
9. Take photographs or videos of any failures or deficiencies if possible, ensure they are accurately labeled and time-stamped.
10. Describe any discussions held with building occupants or managers regarding the deficiencies and their planned corrective actions.
